description: A braceless `if (c) a else b` with the `else` on the SAME line keeps its else branch (S462). Pre-fix the consequent's expression collector swallowed `a else b` and the else branch was dropped at exit 0: `pick(false)` returned "" instead of "no", and `if (@r == "") @r = … else …` failed E-STMT-MISSING-SEMICOLON. Both branches run here: pick(false) gives "no", pick(true) gives "yes".
rationale: §17.6.1 — a bare if-statement has 'standard if-statement semantics'; an `else` that is parsed SHALL NOT be discarded. The braceless body form is exercised by the compiler (#933, #1106 S437) and its else must be kept.
